name: Alcona County, MI
findings: Alcona County has 43 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Alcona County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Alcona County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
